runtime_required: python3 (3.9+); the skill itself is documentation and needs no runtime

verification.note: The eight mutations corrupted the DOCUMENTATION; all eight were caught. The verifier ties every quoted value to what the live service answered. On a host with no vera-preview.service unit the two deployment checks are skipped, so the count is 60 rather than 62.

cross_platform.note: ONE archive serves all three platforms: Windows 10 and 11 ship bsdtar, so `tar -xf` opens the tar.gz there as it does on Linux and macOS. MEASURED on a real Windows 11 machine: the extracted run.bat kept its CRLF line endings and `run.bat test` passed all 92 checks. The verifier finds the venv interpreter in either layout and skips the systemd checks where there is no systemctl, so it runs unchanged on Windows.

install.warning: Two directories with the same skill name make the name ambiguous and the skill unloadable.

privacy.note: The operator's LAN address, device serial and MAC are all placeholdered. The verifier takes the host from VERO_LIVE_HOST.

description: The HTTP API of Vero Station -- a cross-platform controller for AIKE's Vero and Mira devices -- as a reference document for an agent, with a verifier that checks every quoted value against a running service.
